{{Top}}
[[File:Thief-EotECRB.png|thumb|right|250px|A female thief at work]]
A '''thief''' was an individual who made their living by stealing from other individuals. Specialized thieves included pickpockets, who targeted people on the street and relieved them of the contents of their pockets, and safecrackers, who were employed to bypass safe security systems.

==Description==
Many thieves were forced into a life of crime by circumstances, but others revelled in the thrill of "the craft." Thieves that targeted the theft of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were commonly referred to as [[Shipjacker/Legends|shipjackers]]. As they progressed beyond common theft, established thieves could gain a reputation, both in the criminal underworld and in [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]]. The identity of some thieves was never known, and they were instead referred to only by a nickname given to them for their exploits. Truly exceptional thieves often garnered a reputation for being able to steal items considered to be unstealable. Once at the peak of their career, some thieves moved away from actual theft and instead worked as consultants or used their experience to catch others in the trade.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Thieves were looked down on by the galactic society as a whole. Despite this generalized feeling, some thieves became unlikely heroes during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They became part of a necessary lifeline that supplied the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] with vital supplies and equipment, often stolen directly from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installations. Other thieves targeted Imperial-allied governments, stealing from them and then redistributing their haul to the oppressed citizenry.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
